title: A Rainy Day at School
intro: Anvi got wet in the rain at school and wrote about it in her diary. Learn the parts of a diary entry.

sections.title: Match each part of a diary entry to its example.

items.right: It rained during our lunch break.
I felt cold but very happy.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: A diary entry begins with the day and date.
We write 'Dear Diary' at the very end.
In my diary, I write about my own day.
A diary entry tells what will happen next year.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Anvi is writing about earlier today. Circle the correct word.

items.after: soaking wet when I reached home.
cosy when Mama gave me hot milk.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a rainy day you remember. Start each with I.
sections.a: e.g. I wore my yellow raincoat. I jumped in the puddles with my friend.

title: My Birthday Party
intro: Kabir turned eight on Saturday. Help him put his diary entry together.

sections.title: Is it a part of a diary entry? Sort the cards.
Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: My friends ___ (come) to my house at five o'clock.
I ___ (open) all my presents after dinner.

sections.title: Match the order to the part of the diary entry.
Circle the best feelings word.

items.after: when Nani gave me a storybook.
when I saw my big chocolate cake.
when the party ended and my friends went home.

sections.title: Write two sentences about your last birthday. Say how you felt.
sections.a: e.g. I cut a mango cake with my cousins. I felt very happy.

title: A Visit to Grandpa's Farm
intro: Zoya spent Sunday on her grandpa's farm near Pune. Help her write about it.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Circle True or False.

items.q: In a diary we use the word I for ourselves.
We write what happened in the past tense.
The date goes at the bottom of the entry.
A diary entry can tell how we felt.

sections.title: Complete Zoya's entry. Use: Sunday, Diary, fed, felt.

items.q: I ___ so happy on the farm.

sections.title: Change each sentence to the past tense.

items.q: I pick ripe mangoes from the tree.
items.a: I picked ripe mangoes from the tree.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a visit to a grandparent. Use I and the past tense.
sections.a: e.g. I visited my grandmother in Kochi. I helped her water the plants.

title: The Lost Lunch Box
intro: Omar could not find his lunch box at school today. Read how he wrote about it.

sections.title: Sort the feelings words.
Put Omar's entry in order. Match the number to the line.

items.right: I lost my blue lunch box at school.
I felt worried until my teacher found it.

sections.title: Omar is writing about earlier today. Circle the correct word.

items.after: her sandwich with me when the bell rang.
the box near the library in the morning.

sections.title: Write the feelings word. Use: worried, thankful, happy.

items.q: I could not find my lunch box, so I felt ___.
Tia shared her food. I felt ___ to have a kind friend.
My teacher found the box, so I felt ___ again.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a time you lost something.
sections.a: e.g. I lost my red pencil in the park. I felt sad, but my brother found it.

title: Diwali Night
intro: Ishaan's family celebrated Diwali at home in Sharjah. Help him finish his diary entry.

sections.title: Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: In the morning we ___ (clean) the whole house.
I ___ (draw) a rangoli at the door.

sections.title: Sort the verbs.
Circle True or False.

items.q: 'Dear Diary' comes before the day and date.
'I lit a diya' is written in the past tense.
A diary entry ends with my name.
In his own diary, Ishaan writes 'Ishaan lit a diya' and not 'I lit a diya'.

sections.title: Answer in a full sentence. Begin with I felt.

items.q: How did Ishaan feel when the diyas glowed?
items.a: e.g. I felt joyful when the diyas glowed.

sections.title: Write a short diary entry about a festival you enjoyed.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today we celebrated Onam. I ate a big meal on a banana leaf. I felt very happy. (Check for the past tense and a feelings word.)

title: A Day at the Aquarium
intro: Leila's class went to see the fish at a big aquarium in Dubai. Write the day in her diary.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Leila plans her entry. Match each question to her note.
Leila is writing about this morning. Circle the correct word.

items.after: over our heads in the tunnel.
a class photo near the tank.

sections.title: Change each sentence to the past tense.

items.q: The turtle hides behind a rock.
items.a: The turtle hid behind a rock.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a class trip. Say how you felt.
sections.a: e.g. We visited a science museum. I felt curious when I saw the robots.

title: Sports Day Race
intro: Tanmay ran in the relay race on Sports Day. Some things went well and some did not.

sections.title: Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: I ___ (run) as fast as I could.

sections.title: Match what happened to the feeling.

items.left: My team won the gold medal.
I stood at the start line and my legs shook.
I ran in four races in one morning.
Papa came to watch without telling me.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: A diary entry can tell about good things and bad things.
'I ran fast' is in the past tense.
'I run fast' tells about something that is over.
We write our feelings before the day and date.

sections.title: Finish each sentence in your own words.

items.a: e.g. I felt proud when I finished the race.
e.g. I felt nervous because many people were watching.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a race or game you played.
sections.a: e.g. I played football with my class. We scored two goals and I felt great.

title: The New Puppy
intro: A little brown puppy came to live with Meher's family on Friday. She cannot wait to tell her diary.

sections.title: Does the line tell what happened or a feeling? Sort.
Write the past tense of each verb.
Meher writes at bedtime about her day. Circle the correct word.

items.after: his tail when he saw me.

sections.title: Complete the entry. Use: Dear, Friday, Meher.
Write a diary entry about a pet or an animal you met.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today I met my neighbour's parrot. It said hello to me. I felt surprised and happy. (Check for the past tense and a feelings word.)

title: A Train Ride to Jaipur
intro: Rehan travelled from Delhi to Jaipur by train with his aunt. Help him write about the journey.

sections.title: Write 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 to put the entry in order.

items.q: ___ We sat by the window and drank hot tea.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Is the sentence right for Rehan's own diary about today? Circle True or False.

items.q: I ate hot samosas on the train.
Rehan eats hot samosas on the train.

sections.title: Rewrite each sentence the diary way. Use I and the past tense.

items.q: Rehan waves to the tea seller.
items.a: I waved to the tea seller.

sections.title: Write two sentences about a journey you made.
sections.a: e.g. I went to Goa by aeroplane. I looked at the clouds from my window.

title: Eid at My Cousin's House
intro: Amna's family drove to Ajman to celebrate Eid with her cousins. Read and complete her diary.

sections.title: Amna is writing at night. Circle the correct word.
Sort the feelings words.
Write the feeling. Use: excited, shy, thankful, sleepy.

items.q: I woke up early because I was ___ about Eid.
I felt ___ when a new aunt asked me to sing.
I felt ___ for my lovely gifts.
On the drive home at midnight I felt ___.

sections.title: Change each sentence to the past tense.

items.q: We taste sweet dates after lunch.
items.a: We tasted sweet dates after lunch.

sections.title: Write a diary entry about a family celebration.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today was my uncle's wedding. I danced with my cousins. I felt joyful. (Check for the past tense and a feelings word.)

title: The School Play
intro: Nikhil played the lion in the class play. He wrote his diary in a hurry, so help him fix it.

sections.title: One verb is wrong. Write the correct past tense word.

items.q: I speaked my lines loudly. The correct word is ___.
We singed the last song together. The correct word is ___.
I standed in the middle of the stage. The correct word is ___.
Everyone claped for us. The correct word is ___.
The curtain goed up at six o'clock. The correct word is ___.

sections.title: Match each feeling to its reason.

items.right: because the hall was full of people.
because my lion tail fell off.
because my teacher helped me practise.
because the play was over so soon.

sections.title: Circle True or False.

items.q: A diary entry needs the day and date at the top.
'I bowed to the crowd' uses I and the past tense.
'He bows to the crowd' is the right way to write about myself in my diary.

sections.title: Write a diary entry about a time you were on stage or in front of the class. Use because.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today I read a poem in assembly. I felt nervous because everyone looked at me. My teacher smiled, so I felt proud.

title: Camping in the Desert
intro: Sana's family camped for a night among the sand dunes near Al Ain. Help her write a full entry.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Where does each line go in a diary entry? Sort.
Join the two sentences with because.

items.q: I felt scared. I heard a strange sound.
items.a: I felt scared because I heard a strange sound.

items.q: I felt cosy. The fire was warm.
items.a: I felt cosy because the fire was warm.

sections.title: Sana writes about last night. Circle the correct word.

items.after: us a story about a clever camel.

sections.title: Write a full diary entry about a night away from home.
sections.a: e.g. Friday, 2 May. Dear Diary, I slept at my cousin's house. We told stories in the dark. I felt brave. Aisha

title: My Wobbly Tooth
intro: Read Elena's entry: 'Monday, 2 February. Dear Diary, My tooth came out at lunch. I felt a bit scared, then proud. Elena'

sections.title: Read Elena's entry above. Circle True or False.

items.q: The entry has a day and date.
Elena wrote about something that happened at dinner.
Elena wrote about two different feelings.

sections.title: Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: My tooth ___ (wiggle) and then came out.
I ___ (keep) it in a tiny box.
Dadi ___ (smile) and gave me a hug.

sections.title: Match each feelings word to a word that means the same.
Make the sentence better. Add a feeling.

items.q: I showed my tooth to my friends.
items.a: e.g. I felt proud when I showed my tooth to my friends.

sections.title: Write a diary entry about a time something surprising happened to you.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today a butterfly sat on my hand. It stayed for a long time. I felt surprised and calm. (Check for the past tense and a feelings word.)

title: The Science Fair
intro: Dev and his partner Mariam showed a bean plant project at the science fair. Help Dev write a longer entry.

sections.title: Fill in the blank with the past tense of the word in brackets.

items.q: We ___ (plant) five beans in a glass jar.
The beans ___ (grow) tall in two weeks.
Miss Thomas ___ (teach) us how to measure them.
I ___ (write) the heights on a chart.

sections.title: Which lines belong in Dev's diary about the fair? Sort.
Circle the best joining word.

items.before: We watered the beans every day,

sections.title: Rewrite each sentence the diary way. Use I or We and the past tense.

items.q: Dev and Mariam pour water on the beans.
items.a: We poured water on the beans.

items.q: Dev explains the chart to the judge.
items.a: I explained the chart to the judge.

sections.title: Write two more sentences for Dev's entry. Tell how the day ended and how he felt.
sections.a: e.g. We packed up our jar at three o'clock. I felt tired but very proud.

title: Moving to a New House
intro: Farah's family moved from Mumbai to Abu Dhabi this week. She has mixed feelings about it.

sections.title: Write the past tense of each verb.
Circle True or False.

items.q: A person can feel happy and sad on the same day.
A diary entry must tell only about happy things.
'I left my old school' is in the past tense.

sections.title: Name the part of the diary entry. Use: date, greeting, feeling, sign-off.

items.q: 'I felt lonely at first' tells a ___.

sections.title: Answer in a full diary sentence. Start with I.

items.q: What did Farah do in her new room?
items.a: e.g. I hung my drawings on the wall.

items.q: How did Farah feel about leaving her friends?
items.a: e.g. I felt sad because I left my best friends.

sections.title: Write a diary entry about a big change, like a new class or a new home. Give two feelings.
sections.a: e.g. Dear Diary, Today I joined a new class. I felt lonely at first. Then a girl shared her crayons and I felt glad.
